description.narrative:
IDA is the World Bank’s concessional financing arm, providing grants and highly concessional loans to the 75 poorest and most vulnerable low-income countries (LICs) in the world. There are 20 IDA-eligible countries in the Indo-Pacific, of which half are Pacific Island countries.
IDA is a key mechanism for Australia to leverage and deliver support to our region, while simultaneously allowing us to provide support efficiently where we do not have a bilateral presence. Our continued support of IDA demonstrates our solidarity with the development needs of the Global South, in particular the poorest and most vulnerable members of the Indo-Pacific region.
This represents the “investment” component on Australia's IDA20 replenishment (80 per cent).
